en:
As long as you come home well,
that alone will be enough...
I'm always waiting eagerly
for your return.
note: Letter from Shogo's mother (near-duplicate of U03338; its first line was rephrased to fit the narrower 168 px box); 4 lines kept with the JP breaks.
Near-duplicate of U03340; wording kept consistent with it. JP page break kept as a beat.
Shared line (count 7); matches the form used for other craftsmen (U03343, U03345).
Near-duplicate of U02745/U03346; wording kept consistent. Nemoto's gender is unknown; no pronouns used.
Motonari first assumes the bandit robbed Chosuke; the bandit reveals Chosuke's swindle. Sentence split across two sections follows the JP.
Follows the 'Got N gold.' / 'Paid N gold.' forms of earlier slices.
Standard form used in earlier slices (e.g. U01398).
JP page break inside Chosuke's request kept as a hesitant beat.
Follows the wife's illness (U03648); implies the wife has died. Kept implicit as in the JP.
Swordsman's gender unknown: neutral phrasing ('the talking never stopped', 'that one').
Teshima Shogo's mother; near-duplicate of U03395, kept consistent.

en: Gave the medicine to the farmer.
